class: prospective re-run of the FG80 study under a categorical answer contract; the P-F negative attributed to ONE stage (answer encoding at the arm/scorer interface) and re-tested with all five arms, same single-call budget, same scorer

attribution.evidence: R2 typed `representation_feature` as a free `string` and scored by exact JSON equality; the census finds 34-50 of every arm's 80 answers carry the correct feature id decorated (`H_X = 1`, `H_X is active (value 1)`), scored wrong. Under a conservative rendering-normalisation (a second feature id, any connective, any negation or `= 0` in the tail keeps the row WRONG) the R2 paired contrast F2_FULL vs TARGET_ONLY_DIRECT goes from b=30/c=11 (delta -19, p=4.3e-03) to b=4/c=1 (delta -3, p=0.375).
attribution.what_the_census_is_not: descriptive and non-gating; it alters no registered R2 terminal and does not fire or un-fire the P-F trigger, which is a predicate over the frozen R2 campaign

lever.where: the interface contract, applied to every arm identically
lever.what: the categorical endpoint crosses the interface AS a categorical: `answer_contract` names the admissible feature ids and decisions; the output schema enumerates them (`enum`); the encoding instruction names them and forbids decoration; `validate_answer` rejects any non-member (the response is then EXECUTION_FAILED_MODEL_RESPONSE and the run is invalid, never silently rescored)
lever.what_it_does_not_touch: arm procedure texts (imported verbatim from scripts/orion_formal_discovery_arms.py), the task generator (imported verbatim, gen_fg80), the scorer (exact canonical-JSON equality, R2's), the single-call budget, the model channel

constants.statistic: paired McNemar exact (two-sided binomial on discordant pairs) F2_FORMAL_DISCOVERY_FULL vs TARGET_ONLY_DIRECT over the 80 tasks
constants.channel: codex exec, side-by-side binary codex-cli 0.147.0 at ~/.npm-terra/bin/codex on billy-old, requested model gpt-5.6-terra, temperature not exposed by the CLI, --output-schema enforced, max concurrency 3 -- R2's instrument, unchanged
constants.served_model_pin: NOT_EXPOSED_BY_CODEX_CLI__HEADER_IS_REQUEST_ECHO -- carried as the same UNPINNED_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION residual R2 carries; the R3 primary is a within-run contrast so a substitution would have to be arm-selective to bias it, and the arms are dispatched interleaved in one pool

arm_identity_note: per the R2 erratum, F0_PARENT_FEDERATION and STRONGEST_DOMAIN_FORMAL_PARENT are one procedure (PARENT_GENERIC) under two labels; R3 keeps all five ids so that its rows are comparable with R2's row-for-row, but reads four distinct conditions, and no federation claim is made

controls_consumed_by_the_gates.rule: the four census controls (R2 exact counts reproduced; detector fires on a planted variant; detector silent on a different answer; zero rendering variants outside FG80) PASS in the committed FG80_R2_RENDERING_CENSUS_V1.json
generating the 80 tasks twice from the seed is byte-identical, and a different seed changes them (selftest)
the private oracle's sha256 is committed before dispatch, the file is absent from disk during every model call, and the restored file matches the commitment

400/400 responses COMPLETED_PROPOSAL_ONLY with an answer inside the enumerated contract; any EXECUTION_FAILED or out-of-enum answer makes the run invalid and routes CANNOT_CHECK -- an invalid answer is never rescored
every response's resource_receipt.requested_model equals the pin; the served id is NOT available and is reported as such, not as a pass

routing.condition: any control fails, or either the treatment or the parent run is invalid

routing.reading: the study has no dynamic range once decoding is removed; the R2 deficit was an encoding artifact and FG80 cannot discriminate the controller from the bare control -- hypothesis (c), suite, not (a) architecture nor (b) mandate
cannot fire the P-F trigger (a predicate over R2); licenses only a prospectively frozen trigger protocol of its own
the negative stands at the decision level; attribution moves to the arm's procedure -- hypothesis (a) or (b), to be split by a later single-lever test
parity below ceiling: the R2 deficit was the interface; the controller neither beats nor loses to the bare control on FG80

pre_run_reachability_audit.seed_does_something: yes -- selftest asserts a different seed changes the tasks and the same seed reproduces them
pre_run_reachability_audit.hard_gate_at_scale: evaluate is O(400) file reads; the freeze/dispatch/evaluate path was exercised by the selftest and by a 5-task dry generation
pre_run_reachability_audit.contrast_could_exist: per-task correctness is free in both arms; b and c each range 0..80; rows 1-4 are all reachable (selftest exercises each routing row with synthetic inputs)
pre_run_reachability_audit.clause_narrowing: the runner evaluates exactly the routing above; the selftest asserts the constants in this file equal the constants in fg80_r3.py
pre_run_reachability_audit.parent_isolation: every arm gets one call, the same public task, the same contract and the same encoding instruction; the only per-arm difference is the ARM/ARM PROCEDURE lines, exactly as in R2
pre_run_reachability_audit.served_model: NOT pinned by the channel (see constants); disclosed, not cleared
pre_run_reachability_audit.ceiling_control: row 1 names the ceiling as a ceiling; it is the outcome the census predicts (semantic accuracies 73-76/80 in R2) and is registered as NO dynamic range, not as a tie the mechanism earned

pre_run_expectation_disclosed: the census predicts every arm near 0.91-0.95 under the contract; row 1 is the expected terminal. Stated before dispatch so that a ceiling cannot be read afterwards as a surprise or as support.
no_rescue_clause: no constant, arm set, contract, routing row, seed, scorer or channel may change after dispatch begins; a defect found afterwards is recorded in the receipt and repaired under a new identity
